title: Turtle food
description: Food, medicines and feed accepted by the turtle-feeding menu, with their effects and sources.

displayPolicy.reason: Exclude exact meal, debug and alternate entries without a verified normal carried-item source; retain their native records for research.
displayPolicy.evidence: Private six-food source audit retained outside the public repository.

rules.basePoints: The numbers are base points, not guaranteed gains or percentages.
rules.fullness: The initial Fullness change happens first and stops at zero or the turtle’s current Fullness limit. It is not multiplied by age or trust.
rules.scaling: Other current-stat changes and all growth changes are multiplied by age growth and trust, then rounded towards zero. Your turtle can gain less, more, or nothing.
rules.growth: Growth raises the stat’s trained limit, up to that turtle’s own ceiling. Current stats stop at their trained limit. Sand, Water and Mud are terrain aptitude points.
rules.fullnessGrowth: A Fullness growth value changes its trained limit only; the item’s separate Fullness value supplies the meal.
rules.form: Every feeding advances Form by one step in its nine-step cycle; it can improve or worsen.
rules.lifespan: Every feeding uses one remaining-lifespan unit. Eternal Turtles are exempt.
rules.trust: If the total applied current-stat and growth changes are negative, feeding costs up to 8 trust. Otherwise, feeding with the post-race feeding bonus grants up to 16 trust and clears that bonus. Trust stays between 0 and 255. The initial Fullness change does not count towards this total.
rules.fullTurtle: The feeding action is unavailable when the selected turtle is already full.
rules.inventory: You can feed items carried by the player or kept in item storage; the feeding menu reads both directly.
rules.eligibility: The reference includes items accepted by the feeding menu, excluding variants without a verified carried-item source. Sources can be shops, finds or rewards.
rules.duplicates: Some separate native inventory items have the same English name. They remain separate here rather than combining their effects.
